remarks: Palmer Hill! The Luxury Gated Community on the Old Greenwich/Stamford Border. Rarely on market, Fantastic and Highly Desirable 3 Bedrooms or 2 Bedroom + Den/2 Bath midrise condo with 2 terraces. 1 Floor Living. All wood floors, New HVAC, Water Heater, and AC Compressor. Lots of light, great courtyard views, custom window treatments, custom lighting! Open plan living/dining room with large windows, gas fireplace, and French door to a terrace. Gourmet kitchen with breakfast bar, many cabinets, SS appliances, New Dishwasher, Microwave, and Washing Machine. Spacious en-suite primary bedroom suite has ceiling moldings, custom walk in closet, French door to a terrace and a full, en-suite marble bath with 2 sinks. 2nd Bedroom has a custom closet, 3rd bedroom/den has French doors to a 2nd terrace and custom walk-in closet. This home comes with 2 indoor parking spaces, a storage unit, and a bike room. Amenities include a newly remodeled clubhouse, pool, hot tub, fire pit, gym, yoga room, and business center. Dog Friendly! Minutes to I95 and Metro North. Don't Miss this one!
